description_en: Spacious living room with kitchen area Direct access to the balcony 2 comfortable bedrooms 1 bathroom in the matrimonial room 1 day bathroom Distribution corridor The apartment offers a regular layout, maximally usable spaces and is suitable for both family living and investment.
